[[Calling All Thugs (Hard mode)]] | map = [[File:Calling All Thugs map.jpg|Escape Route|250px]] }} Sneak into the mercenaries' meeting for a little bit of recon. ==Quest information== ===Objectives=== * Travel to [[Shadow's Passage]] and investigate the meeting. * Speak with the attendees to find out what the criminals are planning. Avoid the group you are disguised as and mind your tongue. The wrong words will draw unwanted attention. * Go listen to the criminal's speech. Leaving early will blow your cover. * Escape the meeting. * See Guardsman Qao Lin for your reward. ===Reward=== *2,500 [[Experience]] *1,000 [[Gold]] *[[Imperial Guard Requisition Order]] *[[Imperial Commendation]] == Walkthrough == During this solo quest, you will be under the effects of the [[Dastardly Disguise]], which makes you look like a member of one of various thug groups. The quest is straightforward: enter the area, talk to several NPCs, listen to a speech, and then make a hasty retreat. However, there are several pitfalls that can cause the quest to fail: * During the talking phase, giving three bad answers or talking to an NPC that recognizes you as an impostor (i.e. you are disguised as one of them). * During the speech phase, getting too far away from the crowd (e.g. to prepare to escape) — this causes everyone to become hostile and the quest will fail. * During the escape phase, if you leave the area too quickly — wait until your quest log updates your success, otherwise you will not get credit (even if you have done everything else correctly). ; Key triggers * You need to give at least three good answers to the relevant NPCs. * You can start moving away once the PC says ''"What, no, I'm not an imposter."'' ; Skill recommendations * A [[speed boost]] (even [[Drunken Master]]) is helpful to keep you ahead of any foes, but the quest can be completed without one. * It is also possible to distract the foes using [[spirit]]s and [[minion]]s. == NPCs == === Allies & Foes === ''All NPCs begin friendly, but turn hostile by the end of the quest.''
